entries.title: Signal Fires
entries.text: Coastal stations use colored signal fires to warn ships and settlements. The Cinder Bell confirms urgent distress.

entries.title: Tide Roads
entries.text: Some old roads cross the flats and can be walked only during rare low tides. Locals mark them with black stones.

entries.title: Salvage Rights
entries.text: Salvage claims are recorded in ledgers kept by crew speakers. Disputes are settled by witness marks and tide timing.
